Standing shoulder to shoulder, we swallow hard and watch how things unfold.
An unforgivable crime is taking place, stirring up anxiety across the academy.
We have to solve these outrageous incidents ruining our sparkling school life, no matter what.
Yet right now, the girl standing next to me isn't wearing anything under her skirt.

No, no! My train of thought just got completely derailed!

If you forget, you'll leave yourself wide open--are you okay with that, Misa!!
She fidgets, rubbing her inner thighs together. She must be terribly restless.
Still, just a little longer to bear it.
All the conditions are in place. The culprit is sure to come.
